lines.arrive: A little town, on a still afternoon. You've a train to catch, at a quarter past two.
lines.notice: Market day, Saturday. Choir practice, Thursday. A lost cat. Clock repairs, enquire within.
lines.bench: A bench in the sun. The whole town seems to be having a nap.
lines.reads: The town clock says two o'clock. It has always kept good time.
lines.go: Just time to make your train, if you hurry.
lines.true: And the station clock says a quarter past, on the dot. You made it.
lines.night: The evening comes. Then the night. Then the morning.

stopped.text: The town clock never moved. It had stopped at two, the day before. You happened to look at it in one of the two minutes a day it's right.

lines.end: You believed it. It was true. You had good reason, and you caught your train. So did you know what time it was?
